payload.posture: Read Revelation 21:9–27 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the final city lacks a temple because God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple amid light, nations, gates, and life. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
